item.title: FCC Chair Brendan Carr Must Stop Violating the First Amendment
item.description: Today, CDT signed a letter to FCC Chair Brendan Carr asking him to stop using his authority as the head of the Federal Communications Commission to unconstitutionally threaten broadcasters with punishment if they don’t engage in speech he and President Trump prefer.
